title: David Cursed and Betrayed

questions.question: Who met David with donkeys and provisions?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:1 (ESV): "...Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him..."

questions.question: What did Ziba say Mephibosheth was doing?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:3 (ESV): "...he said, 'Today the house of Israel will give me back the kingdom of my father.'"

questions.question: Who cursed David and threw stones at him?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:5 (ESV): "...there came out a man... whose name was Shimei... and he cursed as he came."

questions.question: What did Abishai want to do to Shimei?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:9 (ESV): "...Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and take off his head."

questions.question: Who welcomed Absalom to Jerusalem crying "Long live the king!"?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:16 (ESV): "...Hushai said to Absalom, 'Long live the king! Long live the king!'"

questions.question: What advice did Ahithophel give Absalom regarding David's concubines?
options: Go in to them in the sight of all Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Go in to them in the sight of all Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:21 (ESV): "Ahithophel said to Absalom, 'Go in to your father's concubines... that all Israel may hear that you have made yourself a stench to your father.'"

questions.question: Where was the tent pitched for Absalom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:22 (ESV): "So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof. And Absalom went in to his father's concubines..."

questions.question: The counsel of Ahithophel was like inquiring of ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:23 (ESV): "Now in those days the counsel that Ahithophel gave was as if one consulted the word of God..."

questions.question: What provisions did Ziba bring?
options: Bread, raisins, summer fruits, and wine
questions.correctAnswer: Bread, raisins, summer fruits, and wine
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:1 (ESV): "...200 loaves of bread, 100 bunches of raisins, 100 of summer fruits, and a skin of wine."

questions.question: Shimei was from the family of the house of ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:5 (ESV): "...a man of the family of the house of Saul..."

questions.question: David said, "It may be that the Lord will look on the ______ done to me, and... repay me with good."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:12 (ESV): "It may be that the LORD will look on the wrong done to me..."

questions.question: Where did David and his people become weary and refresh themselves?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:14 (ESV): "And the king... arrived weary at the Jordan. And there he refreshed himself."

questions.question: What did Shimei call David?
options: A man of blood and a worthless fellow
questions.correctAnswer: A man of blood and a worthless fellow
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:7 (ESV): "...Get out, get out, you man of blood, you worthless fellow!"

questions.question: Why did David stop Abishai from killing Shimei?
options: The Lord has said to him, "Curse David"
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord has said to him, "Curse David"
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:10 (ESV): "...if he curses because the LORD has said to him, 'Curse David,' who then shall say, 'Why have you done so?'"

questions.question: What question did Absalom ask Hushai?
options: Is this your loyalty to your friend?
questions.correctAnswer: Is this your loyalty to your friend?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 16:17 (ESV): "And Absalom said to Hushai, 'Is this your loyalty to your friend? Why did you not go with your friend?'"

key_verse_text: And David said to Abishai... “Behold, my own son seeks my life; how much more now may this Benjaminite! Leave him alone, and let him curse, for the LORD has told him to.” (ESV)
